citations.quote:
[name="奥克里"]各位来宾好，我是你们的园区讲解员奥克里！
[name="奥克里"]我理解，被关在这么个小黑匣子里实在是无聊又吊人胃口……不过为了登上六百米的高空欣赏全泰拉独一无二的景致，一切都是值得的！
[dialog]
[cgitem(image="cgitem_68_i01_2", style="cg",pfrom = "0,-10",pto = "0,-600",pduration = 0.5,aFrom=1,aTo=0,aduration=0.5,layer = 2,block=true)]
[hidecgitem(image="cgitem_68_i01_2",block=true)]
[PlaySound(key="$d_avg_bubble_cartoon_2")]
[cgitem(image="cgitem_68_i01_1", style="cg",pfrom = "0,-300",pto = "0,10",pduration =0.5, sfrom =0.8 ,sto = 1, sduration = 0.5, layer = 2,block=true)]
[cgitem(image="cgitem_68_i01_1", style="cg",pfrom = "0,10",pto = "0,-10",pduration =0.2, layer = 2,block=true)]
[name="奥克里"]四十秒后，我们将踏上园区的浮空结构层。在此之前，请各位思考一个问题——天空究竟会为我们的生活带来什么样的不同？
[dialog]
[hidecgitem(image="cgitem_68_i01_1",block=true)]
[delay(time=0.3)]
[PlaySound(key="$d_avg_OriginiumArts_llfather", volume=0.6)]
[cgitem(image="cgitem_68_i01_7", style="cg",pfrom = "-300,-500",pto = "-300,0",pduration =1,layer =1,block=true)]
[cgitem(image="cgitem_68_i01_7", style="cg",pfrom = "-300,0",pto = "-300,-20",pduration =0.5, layer =1,block=true)]
[name="奥克里"]今天在下层展区参观的时候，各位或许已经体验过把四只轮胎替换成源石推进器的“飞车”。
[dialog]
[PlaySound(key="$d_avg_slip",volume=1)]
[delay(time=0.3)]
[cgitem(image="cgitem_68_i01_7", style="cg",pfrom = "-300,-20",pto = "900,-20",pduration =0.8,layer =1,block=true)]
[hidecgitem(image="cgitem_68_i01_7",block=true)]
[name="奥克里"]很快，我们就会把所有带轮子和履带的东西统统扔进博物馆，不管是婴儿车，还是移动城市。
[dialog]
[PlaySound(key="$clink", volume=1)]
[cgitem(image="cgitem_68_i01_4", style="cg",pfrom = "0,-200",pto = "0,10",pduration =0.5, layer =1,block=true)]
[cgitem(image="cgitem_68_i01_4", style="cg",pfrom = "0,10",pto = "0,-10",pduration =0.5, layer =1,block=true)]
[PlaySound(key="$d_avg_drinksoda_straw", volume=1)]
[name="奥克里"]今天我们还在纠结，在即将到来的夏日，度假究竟是去米诺斯还是汐斯塔。
[name="奥克里"]但很快，各位的选择困难症就会急速加重，每颗星星都会成为可选的旅行目的地。
[dialog]
[cgitem(image="cgitem_68_i01_4", style="cg",pfrom = "0,0",pto = "0,-500",pduration =0.5,layer =1,block=true)]
[hidecgitem(image="cgitem_68_i01_4",block=true)]
[PlaySound(key="$d_avg_plane",volume=0.8)]
[cgitem(image="cgitem_68_i01_5", style="cg",pfrom = "90,-500",pto = "90,0",pduration =1, layer =1,block=true)]
[name="奥克里"]今天的参观结束之后，我们带回去给孩子的礼物，或许是环形实验室的微缩模型，又或许是自制小型火箭的工具箱。
[name="奥克里"]但很快，给孩子征集一位外泰拉的住民作为玩伴，才会是学前教育的潮流之选。
[dialog]
[cgitem(image="cgitem_68_i01_5", style="cg",pfrom = "90,0",pto = "90,700",pduration =1,aFrom=1,aTo=0,aduration=1,layer =1,block=true)]
[hidecgitem(image="cgitem_68_i01_5",block=true)]
[PlaySound(key="$d_avg_inspiration", volume=1)]
[cgitem(image="cgitem_68_i01_6", style="cg",pfrom = "-100,500",pto = "200,100",pduration =1,layer =1,block=true)]
[cgitem(image="cgitem_68_i01_6", style="cg",pfrom = "200,100",pto = "-50,0",pduration =1,layer =1,block=true)]
[name="奥克里"]今晚，我们还会守在收音机旁，打赌电台会不会从成千上万首歌唱天空的歌曲中，选中我们最爱的《晚安，克丽斯腾》来播放。
[name="奥克里"]但很快，我们就会把贝斯和沙哑的嗓音抛在脑后，太阳风会成为新的弦乐，一个星系就是一个定制的八音盒。
[dialog]
[PlaySound(key="$d_avg_kalimbapizz", volume=1)]
[cgitem(image="cgitem_68_i01_6", style="cg",pfrom = "-50,0",pto = "300,-500",pduration =1,afrom=1,ato=0,aduration=0.5,layer =1,block=true)]
[hidecgitem(image="cgitem_68_i01_6",block=true)]
[PlaySound(key="$d_avg_bubble_cartoon_1")]
[cgitem(image="cgitem_68_i01_3", style="cg",sfrom =0.8 ,sto = 1, sduration = 0.5, pfrom = "0,-300",pto = "0,10",pduration = 0.5,layer = 2,block=true)]
[cgitem(image="cgitem_68_i01_3", style="cg",pfrom = "0,10",pto = "0,-10",pduration = 0.2,layer = 2,block=true)]
[name="奥克里"]“天空是哥伦比亚的下一个开拓区”，这不仅仅是杰克逊副总统如今的竞选口号。
[name="奥克里"]“螺旋桨天堂”的存在证明了每个哥伦比亚人都能成为伟大的开拓者，都可以在星荚之外找到一席之地。

contributions.description: 奥克里单向知道克丽斯腾这一公众人物。

directions.reason: 奥克里在面向游客的讲解中明确提及以克丽斯腾命名的歌曲。
克丽斯腾未出场，也没有得知奥克里。

contributions.title: 未许之地
